title: Native ColorMask now reverses UI bits and stops passive normalization
Native_trigger: Normal Effects/NBShader inspector -> Native TABigBlockItem constructor, no Graph condition
before: R/G/B/A menu uses raw bits1/2/4/8. Every paint rewrites rounded raw ColorMask & 15.
after: Menu uses reversed bits8/4/2/1. Write only on control change. A saved R-only raw8 is displayed R instead of A; clicking R alone writes8 instead of1. Out-of-range/fractional stale ColorMask values no longer normalize on paint.
impact: Existing material is unchanged if valid value and no click; same user selection can write different render ColorMask. This is not Graph-only adaptation.
authorization: Root reports prior broad implementation/bugfix authorization, not explicit permission to change each Native main semantic; classify as baseline-defect repair exception candidate pending Root conversation review.
review_recommendation: Root should explicitly classify/approve the original UI mapping defect fix or preserve Native main semantics; do not silently mark behavior unchanged.

title: SetFlagBits(MaterialPropertyBlock) switches float API to integer API
Native_trigger: new NBShaderFlags(native material).SetFlagBits(bits, propertyBlock,index), and every ShaderFlagsBase subclass MPB SetFlagBits caller
before: SetFlagBits MPB uses GetInt/SetInt; Clear/Check already use GetInteger/SetInteger. Float-API/int-API word storage mixed.
after: All MPB operations use GetInteger/SetInteger; Graph override never applies to MPB. Native Material operations remain GetInteger/SetInteger.
impact: Correct integer storage preserves high bits and matches HLSL integer protocol. Existing external MPB writers using legacy SetInt(float) are not migrated; their prior float-backed value will not be merged by the new integer reader. No flag bits/IDs changed.
authorization: Root reports prior broad implementation/bugfix authorization, not explicit permission to change each Native main semantic; classify as baseline-defect repair exception candidate pending Root conversation review.
review_recommendation: Keep as an explicit packed-word bugfix exception candidate; test integer-word high-bit controls and legacy float-word behavior separately.

title: AnimationSheetHelper initializes first frame and wraps next frame
Native_trigger: Enabled/initialized/disabled Graphic or Renderer helper with isParticleBaseShader true, Effects/NBShader/legacy property IDs
before: Init sets time/scale and current ST only; frameIndex/lastIndex/nextIndex/blend not explicitly reset. Next index uses frame+1 without modulo. Renderer OnDisable calls Init (rebind/restart current ST) and clears current flag.
after: Init resets frameIndex=0,last=-1,next=1 or0,blend=0, writes next ST and blend0; next index wraps modulo. Renderer OnDisable clears only acquired material flag without rebinding/resetting ST. Update guards inactive/missing material/framecount and rebinds when renderer shared material changes. Editor delta resets on enable.
impact: Visible first/last-frame blend and disabling/switching/re-enabling Native helper behavior differ from main. Flags1 helperbit remains bit15 and Native OR/AND integer operations untouched. These are real fixes, including the human first-frame review area.
authorization: Root reports prior broad implementation/bugfix authorization, not explicit permission to change each Native main semantic; classify as baseline-defect repair exception candidate pending Root conversation review.
review_recommendation: Separate first-frame/last-frame/helper ownership A/B from Graph protocol bridge tests; retain previous authorized lifecycle fixes only as explicit exception candidates.

title: NBPost camera-shake owner/release and disable handling differ
Native_trigger: NBPostProcessing controllers/manager with CINIMACHINE_3_0 and/or Editor callbacks; no Graph check
before: Camera identity alone controls release; old cached Perlin can keep amplitude on binding switch; manager disable only clears post flag; global SoloCamera always cleared on shake end; inactive editor callback can still update.
after: Controller owner controls release; binding switch stops prior owner Perlin; OnDisable resets active effects; SoloCamera cleared only if owned; inactive callbacks suppressed; newly-created/found Perlin published after camera setup.
impact: Actual camera, screen shake and effect cleanup change versus main. Shader/postprocessing numerical contracts are unchanged; C# lifecycle is not.
authorization: Root explicitly reports historical real bug evidence for this repair; still a repair exception candidate under new strict-main requirement, not automatically behavior-equivalent.
review_recommendation: Record as separate baseline defect fix; do not revert to known shake/disable faults just to claim identical source.

title: Mixed Native/Graph selection is read-only; Native-only core unchanged
Native_trigger: Only mixed-host UI selection; ordinary Native-only selection has IsGraphMaterialHost=false, HasGraphTargets=false, HasMixedHosts=false
before: No Graph host existed; Native per-material edit/sync/tier loop
after: Mixed host GUI and static SyncMaterialState IList both return for the whole selection. Graph-only static Sync performs seed-only PrepareGraphGUIState then skips old projection. Runtime Native+Graph enumerable applies Native in original order then atomically projects the Graph subset.
impact: New capability guard, not a new Native-only default or flags layout. Cross-host behavior must not be used as proof Native semantics unchanged.
authorization: Graph host extension in implementation scope; Native-only branch preservation mechanically checked.
